quotes.text: "captureState should strip the version from the restored Microsoft Graph URL"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The getter normalizes only /v1.0 or /v1.0/ on the exact https://graph.microsoft.com origin to the root pathname. captureState copies the configuration and stores the normalized URL; setState still restores the saved versioned textbox value. The changed test directly distinguishes restored display from normalized capture. Other paths/origins, live endpoint discovery and authentication are outside that proof. No test ran.
title: Exchange settings strip only the root Microsoft Graph v1.0 path during capture
